summary: Tested the 3 new Tax AI features end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend pytest 6/6 PASS covering /api/key-status shape+no-leak, /api/putusan/{id}/ai-summary (fresh/cached/refresh/404/no-asterisks) for both gpt and gemini, and /api/chat SSE for gpt and gemini. UI PASS for all 6 scenarios: search-key-badge 'Kunci Emergent' on Tax Knowledge landing; assistant panel shows model-switch-gpt/gemini + assistant-key-badge 'Kunci Emergent'; gpt default active; clicking Gemini sets active and persists in localStorage ('taxlens-model'='gemini') across reloads; ai-summary-button opens ai-summary-card with loading -> issue/verdict/reasoning(ol x5)/laws/implikasi and ai-summary-meta showing 'GPT 5.6 Terra' then 'GPT 5.6 Terra · tersimpan' on second open (cache working); refresh regenerates; copy and close work; card auto-closes when switching document; chat questions stream successfully for both GPT and Gemini models (citation-list rendered 4 chips for gpt, second response produced too). Zero console errors across the entire session.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /key-status correctly returns env name + source only (no key values). Confirmed no 'sk-', 'AIza', or 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY' leaks in payload.

_assistant_config falls back to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY via os.environ['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY']; this will KeyError if that env var is ever missing. Consider a guarded lookup with a clear 500 message. (Not a blocker today since EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set.)

putusan_ai_summary cache keyed by (document_id, model) + body_hash; refresh:true bypasses correctly. clean() strips asterisks/hash/backticks after JSON parse, which the UI relies on. Verified card contains no '*'.
/chat SSE streams token/done events as documented; done event carries citations list; works for both gpt (gpt-5.6-terra) and gemini (gemini-3-flash-preview) via emergent fallback.
App.js L279 saves assistantModel to localStorage; L280 resets aiSummary on document.id change. Both verified in UI.
seed_data_creation: None. Only AI summary cache rows written for seeded putusan ids put-pph21-2023 and (indirectly) the first database item during UI flow; harmless, keyed by document_id+model.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features (key-status badge, model switch persistence, AI summary with cache/refresh/close/reset) are verified. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_key_status_summary_chat.py and run with pytest -o 'addopts=' (project pytest.ini uses pytest-xdist by default). AI summary generation takes ~15-25s per model; chat SSE ~10-30s. No console errors on any page.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features behave as specified.
